post.summary: Compare two PBIP projects and/or generated LookML packages
post.description:
Auto-detect each upload's source type (PBIP project or LookML package), adapt both
to the same LookML structure, and return a structural diff (views, explores, fields, joins).
Supports all four combinations: PBIP vs PBIP, LookML vs LookML, and either mixed direction.

post.summary: Start a bulk PBIP -> LookML conversion job for a parent folder of many projects
post.description:
Discovers every PBIP project in the upload, starts converting the valid ones in the
background, and returns immediately with a job id plus the discovery summary so the UI
can show 'Found / Valid / Invalid' right away and start polling for progress.

ColumnStatistics.title: ColumnStatistics
ColumnStatistics.description:
Per-column statistics for the Statistics tab.

`null_count`/`min_value`/`max_value` come straight from the parquet
footer (no data read). `distinct_count`/`avg_value` require reading the
column's data and are omitted (`None`) once the file is too large to
scan cheaply - see `_MAX_ROWS_FOR_FULL_STATS` in reader_service.py.
